Inês Martins
Registered General Care Nurse | Nursing Council License No. 94312
Profile Summary
Registered Nurse with 3 years of hospital ward experience in post-operative surgical and
internal medicine care.
Professional Experience
General Care Staff Nurse
CHUC University Hospital (2021-Present)
Direct patient care in surgical ward.
Medication preparation and administration (IV/IM/Oral).
Wound dressing and wound care management.
Vital signs monitoring and patient admission/discharge records.
Education
B.Sc. in Nursing
Coimbra Nursing School (2017-2021)
Core Competencies
Surgical Patient Care, Medication Administration, Catheterization, Infection Prevention &
Control, Basic Life Support, Multidisciplinary Teamwork.
